name: Tennessee Gas Pipeline Northeast Upgrade Project
researcher_notes: Five loops of 30-inch pipe on the Tennessee Gas Pipeline 300 Line, about 40.3 miles in Pennsylvania (Bradford, Wayne and Pike counties) and New Jersey, docket CP11-161. A FERC environmental assessment notice in the Federal Register of 29 Nov 2011 states about 40.3 miles of new 30-inch pipe in five loops and up to 636,000 dekatherms of added capacity (the notice says per year, which is likely a typo for per day). The EIA pipeline projects table for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), row 763, lists it as Completed December 2013, 40.3 miles, 636 MMcf/d added, cost 500 million USD, docket CP11-161. EIA gives diameter 24 inches, the FERC notice 30 inches; staged 30 from the FERC notice, please check. EIA and the Federal Register are separate publishers but the EIA entry likely derives from the filing, so treat independence as moderate. Not an existing row: roster has only the system row P0259 and unrelated TGP projects P2496, P2497, P5601. Length 64.9 km is over the 25 km threshold. Capacity is incremental. Cost 500000000 USD from EIA could be added with ProjectLevelCost if wanted (EIA row 763). No route found; a FERC alignment sheet could be used for route research later. Owner matches existing entity Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co.
